name: mirage
text: Both fixes went out in v1.0.22 (released 21:46 UTC, 14 min before your message), so first check Settings > About shows v1.0.22; if it says v1.0.21 or older, update and both should change. If it IS v1.0.22 and either still happens: (1) bids: v1.0.22 rounds a bid up to 1 contract only when its sized stake is half a contract or more; a smaller stake (under about 50c of payout) is still refused rather than overbet your Kelly size. Tell me the bid's price/stake as the Kalshi page shows it and I will decide whether to lift the 1-contract floor. (2) lag: Kalshi list now comes from the GitHub engine, but the phone still re-prices rows itself; say which screen lags (Feed, Kalshi tab or toggling) and I will profile it. Logged as CH45.
